WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
            SELECT
                c.id,
                c.topic_id,
                c.parent_id,
                c.body,
                c.created_at,
                c.edited_at,
                c.deleted_at,
                c.author_id,
                0 AS depth
            FROM community_topic_comment c
            WHERE c.id = $1 AND c.topic_id = $2
            UNION ALL
            SELECT
                p.id,
                p.topic_id,
                p.parent_id,
                p.body,
                p.created_at,
                p.edited_at,
                p.deleted_at,
                p.author_id,
                ch.depth - 1
            FROM community_topic_comment p
            INNER JOIN chain ch ON ch.parent_id = p.id
            WHERE ch.depth + $3::int > 0
        )
        SELECT
            ch.id AS "id!",
            ch.topic_id AS "topic_id!",
            ch.parent_id,
            ch.depth AS "depth!",
            ch.body AS "body!",
            ch.created_at AS "created_at!",
            ch.edited_at,
            ch.deleted_at,
            up.user_id AS author_id,
            up.slug AS author_slug,
            up.name AS author_name,
            up.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url,
            up.status AS author_status
        FROM chain ch
        INNER JOIN user_profile up ON up.user_id = ch.author_id
        ORDER BY ch.depth
